title: Tactics Ogre: Let Us Cling Together

info.about: Tactics Ogre: Let Us Cling Together is a 1995 tactical role-playing game developed and published by Quest Corporation for the Super Famicom. It was later ported to the Sega Saturn (1996) and the PlayStation (1997), the latter released in North America in 1998 by Atlus USA.
info.trivia: A full remake by the original team with a rewritten script; Reborn revised it again in 2022.
info.why: Moderate supply and the Reborn release keep the UMD mid-priced.
